label: ALPHA_NON_PRODUCTION

b1Evidence.resolvedBy: wsl --update; wsl --shutdown; Docker Desktop engine restart
b1Evidence.note: Docker Desktop self-updated 28.3.3 -> 29.7.2 mid-session. The new engine started with an empty data store (containers=0 images=0 volumes=0); all previously running containers, images and volumes are gone, including the out-of-tree GalaxusMetaOS stack.

b2Evidence.portRemapRationale: Canonical infra/docker/docker-compose.infra.yml binds 5432/6379, which the out-of-tree GalaxusMetaOS compose project also claims with restart: unless-stopped. B-axis uses 5462/6399 via docker-compose.infra.beta.yml so the two projects can coexist. Compose appends (not replaces) `ports` on file merge, so a standalone file is used rather than an override.

otelCollector.startupLog: Everything is ready. Begin running and processing data.

b4Evidence.caveat: Infra side only. TLS/OTel READY for the SCI OS control plane still requires the process to be started with the overlay env and /v1/tls/health + /v1/otel/health to report READY.

b3Blocker: OIDC_ISSUER / OIDC_CLIENT_ID / OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET / AUTH_MODE are still REPLACE_WITH_* placeholders in config/packaged.beta.overlay.json. Real IdP registration and secrets must be supplied by a human and must never be committed.
rollbackToAlpha: Overlay is session-scoped and was not merged into packaged.json. Restart SCI OS x10 to return to ALPHA-clean; optionally: docker compose -p scios-alpha-beta -f infra/docker/docker-compose.infra.beta.yml -f infra/docker/docker-compose.otel.yml down
